what: The player-facing strings of the Godot-only drill exercises declared in godot/src/modes/drill_extras.gd, Italian first with an English table, resolved by godot/src/modes/drill_text.gd. They live HERE and not in godot/src/locale/locale_data.gd because that file is generated from the frozen browser reference (js/i18n.js) and verified byte-for-byte by tools/i18n-port/verify-i18n-port.mjs: the reference has no fifth exercise, so a hand-written key there would be dropped by the next regeneration. Same resolution chain as the port's locale layer — the reference's own table first, then the requested locale of this file, then its fallback, then the id itself.
placeholders: {name}, the port's own syntax (godot/src/locale/locale.gd::substitute); no id here needs one

it.drill_return_desc: Il servizio lo batte l'avversario: rispondi e manda la palla nella metà avversaria.
it.drill_return_hint: Split-step sul servizio avversario e rispondi: la palla deve rimbalzare nella metà avversaria.
it.drillWhyReturnIn: Risposta dentro: la palla ha passato la rete ed e' rimbalzata nella metà avversaria.
it.drillWhyReturnDeep: Risposta profonda: la palla e' rimbalzata in fondo alla metà avversaria.
it.drillWhyAceAgainst: Ace avversario: il servizio non e' stato risposto.
it.drillWhyNoReturn: Il punto si e' chiuso prima che il tuo lato rispondesse al servizio.
it.drillWhyReturnNet: La risposta non ha passato la rete.
it.drillWhyReturnOut: La risposta ha passato la rete ma e' uscita dal campo avversario.
it.drillWhyReturnLost: La risposta ha passato la rete, ma il punto si e' chiuso prima del rimbalzo.

en.drill_return_desc: The opponents serve: return it and put the ball in the opponent half.
en.drill_return_hint: Split-step on the opponent's serve and return: the ball must bounce in the opponent half.
en.drillWhyReturnIn: Return in: the ball crossed the net and bounced in the opponent half.
en.drillWhyReturnDeep: Deep return: the ball bounced at the back of the opponent half.
en.drillWhyAceAgainst: Opponent ace: the serve was not returned.
en.drillWhyNoReturn: The point closed before your side returned the serve.
en.drillWhyReturnNet: The return did not clear the net.
en.drillWhyReturnOut: The return cleared the net but went out of the opponent court.
en.drillWhyReturnLost: The return cleared the net, but the point closed before it bounced.
